facts.fact: DCD reports Botswana has launched the Digital Delta Data Center, a 1,000 sqm colocation facility in Gaborone owned by the government and operated under BoFiNet; no event date given, so the published date is used.
DCD describes the newly launched Digital Delta Data Center (BoFiNet, Gaborone) as Tier-III certified without naming the certifier; no event date given, so the published date is used.

note: carried from datacentres; no document opened
